caption: The image depicts a wooden figurine of a person dressed in a historical military uniform. The figure stands upright on a round, slightly decorated pedestal with a mottled pattern in red, cream, and brown. The individual is wearing a tall, black bicorne hat. The face is painted a light cream color with simple features, including prominent eyes, eyebrows, and a small goatee. The uniform jacket is primarily black with a central section featuring horizontal red stripes up the front and cuffs, and gold detailing at the collar and wrist area. The trousers are cream-colored with a thin red stripe running down the outside of each leg. The figure is wearing tall, black boots that cover the lower part of the legs. The arms are straight and held close to the sides of the body, with hands resting near the pelvis. The overall composition centers the figure against a neutral, light background.
title: Soldier
